experiment.title: You're handing off a transcript. That's the bug.
experiment.hook: the transcript is not the handoff.
experiment.hypothesis: A mistake-callout hook ('that's the bug') plus a numbered 7-field anatomy list (save-bait) drives saves + shares harder than a pure thesis hook for cold reach.
experiment.caption:
watched a friend hand a half-finished feature off from claude to cursor last week by literally copy-pasting the entire thread. like 60k tokens of back-and-forth. and cursor spent its first ten minutes re-deriving what they'd already settled, then quietly picked a different auth approach because the *why* never crossed over. and i'm like, that's the bug, right there. a transcript is a record of how the work happened, but the next agent doesn't need how. it needs the goal + the definition of done + the decisions and why you landed on them + what it's even allowed to touch. that's a context pack, not a chat log. the prompt ends but the work keeps moving, and if all you pass forward is the transcript, the org forgets why the work exists the second it changes hands...

#aiagents #promptengineering #claude #cursor #buildinpublic #aiops #mcp #devtools

slides.headline: the transcript is not the handoff.
slides.subtext: the next agent doesn't need your transcript. it needs the decision.

slides.headline: a transcript is 40k tokens of how. the next agent needs why.
slides.subtext: so it re-derives the goal, guesses the constraints, and drifts.

slides.headline: the next agent needs more than a summary. it needs a compile.
slides.subtext: stop dumping the conversation. hand over structured context.

slides.headline: a context pack is 7 fields, not a chat log:
decisions + why is the one that matters. it's the whole point.
slides.subtext: without it the next agent re-litigates choices you already made.

slides.headline: structured context in. the agent starts at the goal, not from scratch.
slides.subtext: no re-derivation. no drift. the task outlives the chat.

slides.headline: which of the 7 fields does your handoff drop first?
slides.subtext: i'm building this in the open at useorgx.com. follow for the next teardown.
